conditions: Must be a Slack channel (public or private), not a DM/group message.
The workspace owner (the user holding the Owner role in the workspace) must be a member of the channel.
The channel's creation date must fall before March 1, 2026.
The channel must have exactly 5 members total.
The channel must not already be archived (an already-archived channel can't meaningfully be archived again).
